2609.12305.title: Self-Verifying Anomaly Detection using Explainable AI for Cybersecurity of DER Networks
2609.12305.paper_summary: The rapid growth of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) has significantly expanded the cyber attack surface of modern power grids. Furthermore, increasing sophistication in attack techniques demands anomaly detection systems (ADS) that are accurate, interpretable, and reliable to support DER cybersecurity. While ML-based ADS provide strong detection capabilities, their black-box nature reduces operator trust and limits Security Operation Center's (SOC) ability to effectively interpret alerts and respond, highlighting the need for explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) to ensure transparency and operational confidence. This paper presents an XAI-based anomaly detection framework tailored for DER networks (ExCYDER). The proposed framework uses a self-verifying mechanism that validates ADS alerts to ensure trustworthy decision-making. ExCYDER combines LightGBM with SHAP to check whether each model decision aligns with its feature-attribution evidence, allowing the system to confirm that its internal reasoning is consistent and reliable. Experiments on a realistic DNP3 dataset achieved over 98% detection accuracy, an average rule--SHAP consistency of 44.6%, a SHAP latency of 14.5 ms per alert, and a confidence deviation within 5%, demonstrating stable verification behavior with minimal computational overhead. The framework distinguished between coherent and inconsistent alerts without compromising detection accuracy, demonstrating that integrated verification within XAI-based ADS enhances interpretability, auditability, and operational robustness for DER-focused SOCs.
2609.12305.paper_summary_zh: 分散能源資源（DERs）的快速增長顯著擴大了現代電網的網絡攻擊面。<lb/>此外，攻擊技術的日益複雜化要求異常檢測系統（ADS）具備準確、可解釋和可靠的特性，以支持DER的網絡安全。<lb/>雖然基於機器學習的ADS提供強大的檢測能力，但其黑箱特性降低了操作員的信任，並限制了安全運營中心（SOC）有效解釋警報和作出反應的能力，突顯了可解釋人工智慧（XAI）的必要性，以確保透明度和操作信心。<lb/>本文提出了一種基於XAI的異常檢測框架，專為DER網絡量身定制（ExCYDER）。<lb/>所提出的框架使用自我驗證機制來驗證ADS警報，以確保決策的可信性。<lb/>ExCYDER將LightGBM與SHAP結合，以檢查每個模型決策是否與其特徵歸因證據一致，允許系統確認其內部推理是一致且可靠的。<lb/>在一個現實的DNP3數據集上進行的實驗達到了超過98%的檢測準確率，平均規則--SHAP一致性為44.6%，每個警報的SHAP延遲為14.5毫秒，且置信度偏差在5%以內，顯示出穩定的驗證行為且計算開銷最小。<lb/>該框架在不妨礙檢測準確性的情況下區分了一致和不一致的警報，證明了在基於XAI的ADS中集成驗證能增強可解釋性、可審計性和針對DER的SOC的操作穩健性。
